bridge_chains.narrative: Bandits identify the most informative positions to mutate, game theory finds equilibrium amino acids at those positions, sparse epistasis decomposition validates that the equilibrium captures the dominant interactions, and GNN structural priors predict which position pairs interact — closing a loop from resource allocation through game theory to structural biology.

Diffusion models generate diverse candidate mutation sets guided by inverse folding energy oracles, which are themselves arranged in a multi-fidelity funnel from NLP-style language models to physics-inspired energy functions, with beam search (from machine translation) refining the top candidates at each funnel stage.

QUBO encoding maps the mutation optimization to an Ising model solvable by quantum-inspired annealing, but the same sparse epistasis structure that makes QUBO tractable also supports submodular approximation guarantees for greedy algorithms, which in turn define the rollout policy in MCTS — connecting quantum physics to game AI through the mathematical structure of the fitness landscape.

GNN structural features feed into inverse folding oracles, whose predictions become objectives in a Pareto ensemble rather than a single combined score, and the multi-objective Pareto front is navigated through a cascading funnel that progressively filters with more expensive evaluations — bridging from molecular structure through thermodynamics through decision theory to screening logistics.
